# Build status

Every build with a known manifest up to 23.50, checked chunk by chunk against Epic's CDN on 2026-10-30. 211 builds could be checked, 0 have no manifest that can still be fetched.

Epic prunes chunks from old builds. A build either downloads in full with every preset, or it is missing core files that every preset needs, so picking a smaller preset never rescues a broken build.

Legendary C# ships with this list. Builds that work are marked ✓ in the menu, broken ones show how many files they will be missing. 34.10 and newer are recent enough that Epic still hosts them in full.
